app_tagline: [मैथिली] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [मैथिली] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [मैथिली] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [मैथिली] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [मैथिली] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [मैथिली] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [मैथिली] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [मैथिली] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [मैथिली] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [मैथिली] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [मैथिली] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [मैथिली] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [मैथिली] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [मैथिली] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [मैथिली] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [मैथिली] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [मैथिली] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [मैथिली] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [मैथिली] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [मैथिली] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [मैथिली] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [मैथिली] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [मैथिली] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [मैथिली] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [मैथिली] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [मैथिली] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [मैथिली] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [मैथिली] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [मैथिली] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.

query_help_desk: [mai] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
